name: Carbonyl compounds and carboxylic acid derivatives

questions.q: What is the characteristic functional group present in both aldehydes and ketones?
Which chemical test uses an ammoniacal silver nitrate solution to distinguish aldehydes from ketones, producing a silver mirror on the test tube walls?
What is the purpose of adding 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) reagent to an unknown organic liquid?
a: To test for the presence of a carbonyl group by forming a colored crystalline precipitate

questions.q: Which of the following reagents can be used to specifically confirm the presence of a methyl ketone (or secondary alcohol that oxidizes to one) by forming a pale yellow precipitate of triiodomethane?
a: Iodine in the presence of sodium hydroxide (Iodoform test)

questions.q: What is the primary organic product formed when an aldehyde is oxidized with acidified potassium dichromate(VI) under reflux?
What type of mechanism occurs when a nucleophile attacks the electron-deficient carbonyl carbon of an aldehyde or ketone?

a: Aldehydes contain a carbon-carbon double bond
Aldehydes have a hydrogen atom attached directly to the carbonyl carbon which can be removed during oxidation, whereas ketones have two alkyl groups

questions.q: What is formed when a carboxylic acid reacts with an alcohol in the presence of a strong acid catalyst (such as concentrated sulfuric acid)?
Which derivative of carboxylic acids is the most reactive toward nucleophilic addition-elimination reactions due to the strong electron-withdrawing chlorine atom?
What is the organic product of the reaction between an acyl chloride and excess cold water?
a: A carboxylic acid and hydrogen chloride gas

questions.q: What color change is observed when Fehling's solution is warmed with an aldehyde?
a: Blue solution to a brick-red precipitate of copper(I) oxide

questions.q: Which of the following compounds is produced when ethanoyl chloride reacts with methylamine?

a: Sodium borohydride (NaBH<sub>4</sub>) or lithium aluminium hydride (LiAlH<sub>4</sub>)

questions.q: What functional group is created when a carboxylic acid reacts with phosphorus pentachloride (PCl<sub>5</sub>)?
Why do carboxylic acids have significantly higher boiling points than alkanes of comparable relative molecular mass?
a: They form extensive intermolecular hydrogen bonds between molecules

questions.q: What are the products when an ester is hydrolyzed under alkaline conditions (such as heating with aqueous sodium hydroxide)?

A carboxylic acid and an amine
A carboxylate salt and an alcohol

a: A bright orange or yellow crystalline precipitate forms

By testing its solubility in water

Low-molecular-mass acids are gases while long-chain acids are solids

questions.q: Which reagent will convert propanoic acid directly into propan-1-ol?
a: Lithium aluminium hydride (LiAlH<sub>4</sub>) in dry ether
